title: A framework for window design in delivery schedules
summary: This paper develops a structured framework for the design and dynamic updating of service time windows in delivery and appointment-based systems. We consider a single-server setting with stochastic service and travel times, where customers are promised a time window in which the provider will arrive. The first part of the paper introduces a static window construction method based on a probabilistic threshold criterion, using an analytical approximation of residual travel and service time distributions.
